 Playasia Black Friday 2026 Sale Is Live: 3 Games for $110, Physical Reprints & Free Shipping Over $99
 Shop Playasia’s Black Friday 2026 Sale through Dec 4. Grab rare physical game reprints, 3-for-$110 bundles, discounted gear & free shipping on orders $99+
 P 
 By Playasia Team 
 November 20, 2026 
 · 1 min read
 Share 
 Link copied 
 Black Friday Sale
 The wait is finally over! Today marks the official kickoff of the Playasia Black Friday Sale , running from November 20 through December 4 (5PM HKT) . Whether you are hunting for hard-to-find physical video game reprints, stocking up on official gaming apparel, or upgrading your setup with pro-grade accessories, our biggest shopping event of the year is live right now.
 Unlock Free Worldwide Shipping on Orders Over $99
 We know that building a physical collection is all about maximizing value. Throughout the Black Friday Sale, orders above $99 qualify for Free Shipping . Stock up on multiple bundles, grab that collector’s item you’ve been eyeing, and let us handle the shipping costs straight to your door.
 Terms and Conditions:
 Item Specifications: Each individual item weighs 300g with a volume of 999 cm³ .
 Weight Requirement: To qualify for the promotion, the total order weight must reach maximum of 1900g .
 Black Friday Sale Highlights & Bundle Deals
 To make it easier to navigate the deals, we’ve organized this year’s promotion into curated bundles and category-wide markdowns.
 Deal / Category Offer Details Best For 
 The Physical Reprint Special pricing on selected physical video games on reprint Collectors & physical media enthusiasts 
 3 Games for $110 Mix and match 3 eligible titles for $110 USD (separate from Physical Reprint) Backlog builders & multi-platform gamers 
 Shikhondo: Blue Pieta 30% Off official Steam Key (Instant Digital Delivery) PC gamers & bullet-hell shmup fans 
 T-Shirt Bundle Any 2 eligible official gaming/anime tees for $60 USD Everyday gamer style & holiday gifting 
 Music Bundle Any 3 eligible official game/anime soundtracks for $60 USD Audiophiles & VGM collectors 
 Merch, Toys & Gear Deep discounts across figures, plushies, controllers & peripherals Desk setups, display shelves & stocking stuffers 
 Shop the Sale Before Stock Runs Out
 Quantities on physical reprints, limited-edition soundtracks, and seasonal bundles are strictly limited. Head over to the Playasia Black Friday 2026 Sale hub today to claim your favorites before December 4 at 5PM HKT!
